title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Advantages of Remote Work for Employees
prompt: In many countries, working from home has become more common because of improvements in technology. Some people believe that this shift brings significant advantages for employees. To what extent do you agree that remote work offers more advantages than disadvantages for employees? In your answer, discuss at least two advantages and any disadvantages you consider relevant, and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作Task 2练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目要求，明确表达你的立场，讨论远程办公对雇员的至少两个优势及可能的劣势，并给出个人观点。文章不少于250词。
